mainRubrics.roman: Din ke purvahn (subah ke baad, dopahar se pehle) mein thandi lagti hai.

mainRubrics.en: You get chills after being frightened.
mainRubrics.hi: डर या भय लगने के बाद ठंड लगने लगती है।
mainRubrics.roman: Dar ya bhay lagne ke baad thandi lagne lagti hai.

mainRubrics.en: You get chills after experiencing grief or deep sadness.
mainRubrics.hi: दुख या शोक के बाद ठंड लगने लगती है।
mainRubrics.roman: Dukh ya shok ke baad thandi lagne lagti hai.

mainRubrics.en: You feel chilly but no feeling of heat follows the chill.
mainRubrics.hi: ठंड लगती है लेकिन बाद में बुखार नहीं आता।
mainRubrics.roman: Thandi lagti hai lekin baad mein bukhar nahi aata.

mainRubrics.en: You feel chilly after getting overheated or too warm.
mainRubrics.hi: जब शरीर बहुत गर्म हो जाए तो ठंड लगने लगती है।
mainRubrics.roman: Jab sharir bahut garam ho jae to thandi lagne lagti hai.

mainRubrics.en: You feel a strong desire or need for someone to press down or hold you firmly during the chills.
mainRubrics.hi: ठंड लगती है और किसी के दबाए रखने की इच्छा होती है।
mainRubrics.roman: Thandi lagti hai aur kisi ke dbaaye rakhne ki ichcha hoti hai.

mainRubrics.en: Your whole body feels icily cold, much colder than a normal chill.
mainRubrics.hi: पूरे शरीर में बर्फ जैसी ठंड लगती है।
mainRubrics.roman: Pure sharir mein barf jaisi thandi lagti hai.

mainRubrics.en: You feel cold on the inside of your body, as if the coldness is coming from within rather than from outside.
mainRubrics.hi: अंदर से ठंड लगती है।
mainRubrics.roman: Andar se thandi lagti hai.

mainRubrics.en: A chilly feeling that is related to lying down.
mainRubrics.hi: लेटने पर ठंड लगती है।
mainRubrics.roman: Letne par thandi lagti hai.

mainRubrics.en: Chills that are connected to the menstrual period.
mainRubrics.hi: माहवारी के समय ठंड लगती है।
mainRubrics.roman: Mahwari ke samay thandi lagti hai.

mainRubrics.en: Chills that come on after mental effort or concentration.
mainRubrics.hi: दिमागी मेहनत के बाद ठंड लगती है।
mainRubrics.roman: dimagi mehnat ke baad thandi lagti hai.

mainRubrics.en: A chill that comes on at midnight.
mainRubrics.hi: आधी रात को ठंड लगती है।
mainRubrics.roman: aadhi raat ko thandi lagti hai.

mainRubrics.en: A chill that comes on in the morning.

mainRubrics.en: A chill that comes on at night.

mainRubrics.roman: raat ko thandi lagti hai.

mainRubrics.en: A chill that comes on at noon.

mainRubrics.en: Chills that come on together with pain.

mainRubrics.en: The chills follow a regular repeating pattern.
mainRubrics.hi: ठंड एक निश्चित समय पर बार-बार आती है।
mainRubrics.roman: Thandi ek nischit samay par bar-bar aati hai.

mainRubrics.en: A severe, dangerous type of chill.
mainRubrics.hi: ठंड का दौरा बहुत खतरनाक और गंभीर होता है।
mainRubrics.roman: Thandi ka daura bahut khatarnak aur gambhir hota hai.

mainRubrics.en: Chills that occur at the same time as sweating.
mainRubrics.hi: ठंड के दौरान पसीने से जुड़ी समस्या होती है।
mainRubrics.roman: Thandi ke dauran paseene se judi samasya hoti hai.

mainRubrics.en: The chills keep coming later and later each time, gradually shifting to a later hour.
mainRubrics.hi: ठंड का दौरा अपने तय समय से देर से आता है।
mainRubrics.roman: Thandi ka daura apne tay samay se der se aata hai.

mainRubrics.en: The chilly feeling is the dominant or strongest part of the illness.
mainRubrics.hi: ठंड का हिस्सा बाकी सब से ज्यादा तेज और लंबा रहता है।
mainRubrics.roman: Thandi ka hissa baki sab se zyada tej aur lamba rehta hai.

mainRubrics.en: A chill pattern that repeats every four days.
mainRubrics.hi: ठंड का दौरा हर चौथे दिन आता है।
mainRubrics.roman: Thandi ka daura har chauthe din aata hai.

mainRubrics.en: A chill pattern that repeats every day.
mainRubrics.hi: ठंड का दौरा हर रोज़ आता है।
mainRubrics.roman: Thandi ka daura har roz aata hai.

mainRubrics.en: A chill that comes on when getting up or rising up.
mainRubrics.hi: उठने पर ठंड लगने लगती है।
mainRubrics.roman: Uthne par thandi lagne lagti hai.

mainRubrics.en: A chill that comes on after hearing sad news.
mainRubrics.hi: बुरी खबर सुनने से ठंड लगने लगती है।
mainRubrics.roman: Buri khabar sunne se thandi lag ne lagti hai.

mainRubrics.en: A chill that comes on from exposure to sewer gas or bad drain smells.
mainRubrics.hi: सीवर या नाली की बदबू वाली गैस से ठंड लग जाती है।
mainRubrics.roman: Sewer ya nali ki badbu wali gas se thandi lag jati hai.

mainRubrics.en: A chill with noticeable shaking or shivering of the body.
mainRubrics.hi: ठंड के साथ कंपकंपी होती है।
mainRubrics.roman: Thandi ke saath kampkampi hoti hai.

mainRubrics.en: I feel a chill along the sides of my body.
mainRubrics.hi: शरीर के एक तरफ ठंड लगती है।
mainRubrics.roman: Sharir ke ek taraf thandi lagti hai.

mainRubrics.en: I feel a chill in specific separate parts of my body rather than all over.
mainRubrics.hi: शरीर के किसी एक खास हिस्से में ठंड लगती है।
mainRubrics.roman: Sharir ke kisi ek khas hisse mein thandi lagti hai.

mainRubrics.en: My chills get better when I sit down.
mainRubrics.hi: बैठने पर ठंड कम हो जाती है।
mainRubrics.roman: Baithne par thandi kam ho jati hai.

mainRubrics.en: I have chills that are connected to sleep.
mainRubrics.hi: नींद के दौरान या नींद से जुड़ा ठंड लगना।
mainRubrics.roman: Nind ke dauran ya nind se juda thandi lagna.

mainRubrics.en: I tend to get chills in the spring season.
mainRubrics.hi: बसंत के मौसम में ठंड लगती है।
mainRubrics.roman: Basant ke mausam mein thandi lagti hai.

mainRubrics.en: My chills are connected to having a bowel movement.
mainRubrics.hi: शौच के समय के आसपास ठंड लगती है।
mainRubrics.roman: Shauch ke samay ke aaspaas thandi lagti hai.

mainRubrics.en: I tend to get chills in stormy weather.
mainRubrics.hi: तूफानी या आँधी-तूफान वाले मौसम में ठंड लगती है।
mainRubrics.roman: Toofani ya aandhi-toofan wale mausam mein thandi lagti hai.

mainRubrics.en: I tend to get chills in the summer.
mainRubrics.hi: गर्मी के मौसम में ठंड लगती है।
mainRubrics.roman: Garmi ke mausam mein thandi lagti hai.

mainRubrics.en: My chills get better when I am out in the sunshine.
mainRubrics.hi: धूप में जाने से ठंड कम हो जाती है।
mainRubrics.roman: Dhoop mein jane se thandi kam ho jati hai.

mainRubrics.en: Swallowing makes my chills worse.
mainRubrics.hi: कुछ निगलने पर ठंड और बढ़ जाती है।
mainRubrics.roman: Kuch nigalne par thandi aur badh jati hai.

mainRubrics.en: I get a chill that comes back every third day (a tertian pattern).
mainRubrics.hi: ठंड हर तीसरे दिन आती है।
mainRubrics.roman: Thandi har tisre din aati hai.

mainRubrics.en: Just thinking about my chill is enough to bring it on or make it worse.
mainRubrics.hi: जब ठंड लगने के बारे में सोचते हैं तो ठंड और बढ़ जाती है।
mainRubrics.roman: Jab thandi lagne ke bare mein sochte hain to thandi aur badh jati hai.

mainRubrics.en: My chills happen at a particular or regular time of day.
mainRubrics.hi: ठंड किसी खास समय पर लगती है।
mainRubrics.roman: Thandi kisi khas samay par lagti hai.

mainRubrics.en: Being touched makes my chills worse.
mainRubrics.hi: छूने पर ठंड और बढ़ जाती है।
mainRubrics.roman: Chhune par thandi aur badh jati hai.

mainRubrics.en: I get chills with trembling and shivering.
mainRubrics.hi: ठंड के साथ-साथ कँपकँपी और थरथराहट होती है।
mainRubrics.roman: Thandi ke saath-saath kapkapi aur tharthrahat hoti hai.

mainRubrics.id: uncovered, wants to be, with cold, dry skin, but desires to be covered with heat and sweat
mainRubrics.en: During a chill, I want to be uncovered because my skin feels cold and dry, but when I have heat and sweating I want to be covered up.
mainRubrics.hi: ठंड लगने पर, जब तक ठंड हो तब तक कपड़े हटाना चाहते हैं क्योंकि त्वचा ठंडी और सूखी होती है, लेकिन जब बुखार और पसीना हो तो ढकना चाहते हैं।
mainRubrics.roman: Thandi lagne par, jab tak thandi ho tab tak kapde hatana chahte hain kyonki tvcha thandi aur sukhi hoti hai, lekin jab bukhar aur pasina ho to dhakna chahte hain.

mainRubrics.en: Uncovering or exposing my body brings on or triggers a chill.

mainRubrics.roman: Kapda hatane par thandi lagti hai.

mainRubrics.en: I feel the chill mainly in the upper part of my body.
mainRubrics.hi: शरीर के ऊपरी हिस्से में ठंड लगती है।
mainRubrics.roman: Sharir ke upri hisse mein thandi lagti hai.

mainRubrics.en: My chills are connected to passing urine.

mainRubrics.roman: Peshaab ke samay ke aaspas thandi lagti hai.

mainRubrics.en: I get a chill after being angry or upset.
mainRubrics.hi: गुस्सा या मन खराब होने के बाद ठंड लगती है।
mainRubrics.roman: Gussa ya man kharab hone ke baad thandi lagti hai.

mainRubrics.en: I get an extremely strong or intense chill.

mainRubrics.en: A chilly feeling that comes on around the time of waking.

mainRubrics.roman: Nind se jagne par thandi lagne lagti hai.

mainRubrics.en: A chilly feeling that comes on while walking.

mainRubrics.roman: Chalte-phirte samay thandi lagti hai.

mainRubrics.en: A chilly feeling even though the body feels warm to the touch.

mainRubrics.roman: Garmi mein bhi thandi lagti hai.

mainRubrics.en: A chilly feeling related to being in a warm room.

mainRubrics.en: A chilly feeling related to warmth or warm conditions.

Linked to time of day.roman: Shaam 6 baje se shuru hokar subah 4 baje tak thand lagti hai aur kampkampi hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Chill, 6 p.m., to, lasting, until 5 a.m.
Linked to time of day.en: A chill that starts at 6 in the evening and lasts until 5 in the morning.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम 6 बजे से शुरू होकर सुबह 5 बजे तक ठंड लगती है और कँपकँपी होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Shaam 6 baje se shuru hokar subah 5 baje tak thand lagti hai aur kampkampi hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A chill that starts at 6 in the evening and lasts until midnight.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम 6 बजे से आधी रात तक ठंड लगती है और कँपकँपी होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Shaam 6 baje se aadhi raat tak thand lagti hai aur kampkampi hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Chill, 7 a.m. to 9 a.m., one day hard chill, 12 a.m., next, light one
Linked to time of day.en: A chill that comes on between 7 and 9 in the morning — one day it is a severe shaking chill, and the next day at noon it is only a mild chill.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह 7 बजे से 9 बजे के बीच ठंड लगती है — एक दिन तेज़ कँपकँपी होती है और अगले दिन रात 12 बजे हल्की ठंड लगती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah 7 baje se 9 baje ke beech thand lagti hai — ek din tez kampkampi hoti hai aur agle din raat 12 baje halki thand lagti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A chill that comes on between 7 and 10 in the evening.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम 7 बजे से रात 10 बजे तक ठंड लगती है और कँपकँपी होती है।

Linked to time of day.path: Chill, afternoon, 3 p.m., lasting until bed time
Linked to time of day.en: A chill that starts at 3 in the afternoon and lasts until bedtime.
Linked to time of day.hi: दोपहर 3 बजे ठंड लगती है जो रात को सोने के समय तक बनी रहती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Dopahar 3 baje thand lagti hai jo raat ko sone ke samay tak bni rahti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A chill that comes on between 4 and 8 in the afternoon.
Linked to time of day.hi: दोपहर 4 बजे से रात 8 बजे तक ठंड लगती है और कँपकँपी होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Dopahar 4 baje se raat 8 baje tak thand lagti hai aur kapkapi hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Chill, afternoon, constantly increasing chilliness without subsequent heat or perspiration
Linked to time of day.en: An afternoon chill that keeps steadily increasing but is never followed by a hot phase or sweating.
Linked to time of day.hi: दोपहर बाद ठंड लगती रहती है और लगातार बढ़ती जाती है — न बाद में गर्मी आती है, न पसीना।
Linked to time of day.roman: Dopahar baad thand lagti rahti hai aur lagatar badhti jati hai — na baad mein garmi ati hai, na pasina.

Linked to time of day.en: An afternoon chill that is followed by a feeling of heat afterward.
Linked to time of day.hi: दोपहर बाद पहले ठंड लगती है, फिर उसके बाद गर्मी चढ़ती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: dophar baad pehle thandi lagti hai, phir uske baad garmi chadti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: An afternoon chill that lasts for 4 hours.
Linked to time of day.hi: दोपहर बाद कंपकंपी आती है जो लगातार 4 घंटे तक रहती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: dophar baad kampkampi aati hai jo lagatar 4 ghante tak rahti hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Chill, afternoon, lasting until falling asleep in the evening
Linked to time of day.en: An afternoon chill that continues until you fall asleep in the evening.
Linked to time of day.hi: दोपहर बाद कंपकंपी आती है जो शाम को नींद आने तक बनी रहती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: dophar baad kampkampi aati hai jo shaam ko neend aane tak bani rahti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: An afternoon chill that lasts all the way through until the next morning.
Linked to time of day.hi: दोपहर बाद कंपकंपी शुरू होती है जो अगली सुबह तक चलती रहती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: dophar baad kampkampi shuru hoti hai jo agli subah tak chalkati rahti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A chill that comes on in the afternoon after sleeping (a nap or rest).
Linked to time of day.hi: दोपहर में सोकर उठने के बाद कंपकंपी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: dophar mein sokar uthne ke baad kampkampi aati hai.

Comes with other symptoms.path: Chill, afternoon, 4 p.m. to 8 p.m., with icy coldness and goose flesh
Comes with other symptoms.en: A chill that comes on between 4 and 8 in the afternoon, with an intensely icy cold feeling and goose bumps all over the skin.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: दोपहर बाद 4 बजे से 8 बजे के बीच कंपकंपी होती है, बर्फ जैसी ठंड लगती है और रोंगटे खड़े हो जाते हैं।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: Dopahar baad 4 baje se 8 baje ke beech kapkapi hoti hai, barf jaisi thand lagti hai aur rongte khade ho jate hain.

Comes with other symptoms.path: Chill, afternoon, 4 p.m. to 8 p.m., with numb hands and feet icy cold at 7 p.m.
Comes with other symptoms.en: A chill that comes on between 4 and 8 in the afternoon, with numbness in the hands and feet that become icy cold at around 7 in the evening.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: दोपहर बाद कंपकंपी होती है, हाथ-पैर सुन्न हो जाते हैं और शाम 7 बजे बर्फ जैसे ठंडे हो जाते हैं।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: Dopahar baad kapkapi hoti hai, hath-pair sunn ho jate hain aur sham 7 baje barf jaise thande ho jate hain.

Comes with other symptoms.path: Chill, afternoon, heat
Comes with other symptoms.en: A chill that occurs in the afternoon along with a feeling of heat.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: दोपहर बाद ठंड लगती है और साथ में गर्मी भी चढ़ती है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: dophar baad thandi lagti hai aur saath mein garmi bhi chadti hai.

Comes with other symptoms.path: Chill, afternoon, heat, and sweat, with, at 5 p.m.
Comes with other symptoms.en: A chill that comes on at 5 in the afternoon, accompanied by heat and sweating at the same time.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: शाम 5 बजे ठंड, गर्मी और पसीना — तीनों एक साथ आते हैं।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: shaam 5 baje thandi, garmi aur pasina — tinon ek saath aate hain.

Comes with other symptoms.path: Chill, afternoon, perspiration
Comes with other symptoms.en: A chill in the afternoon that is associated with perspiration (sweating).
Comes with other symptoms.hi: दोपहर बाद ठंड लगती है और पसीना भी आता है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: dophar baad thandi lagti hai aur pasina bhi ata hai.

Comes with other symptoms.path: Chill, afternoon, perspiration, with
Comes with other symptoms.en: An afternoon chill that comes along with sweating.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: दोपहर बाद कंपकंपी के साथ-साथ पसीना भी आता है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: dophar baad kampkampi ke saath-saath pasina bhi ata hai.

Comes with other symptoms.path: Chill, afternoon, perspiration, with, cold
Comes with other symptoms.en: An afternoon chill that comes along with cold sweating.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: दोपहर बाद ठंड लगती है और साथ में ठंडा पसीना भी आता है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: dophar baad thandi lagti hai aur saath mein thanda pasina bhi ata hai.

Comes with other symptoms.path: Chill, afternoon, violent chill with thirst and red face
Comes with other symptoms.en: A severe chill in the afternoon accompanied by a strong thirst and a flushed red face.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: दोपहर बाद तेज़ कंपकंपी आती है, प्यास लगती है और चेहरा लाल हो जाता है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: dophar baad tez kampkampi aati hai, pyas lagti hai aur chehera lal ho jata hai.

Linked to bowel movement.en: A chill that comes on in the afternoon after having diarrhea.
Linked to bowel movement.hi: दोपहर बाद दस्त होने के बाद कंपकंपी आती है।
Linked to bowel movement.roman: Dopahar baad dast hone ke baad kapkapi ati hai.

Linked to eating/digestion.en: A chill that comes on in the afternoon after eating dinner.
Linked to eating/digestion.hi: शाम को खाना खाने के बाद कंपकंपी आती है।
Linked to eating/digestion.roman: Sham ko khana khane ke baad kapkapi ati hai.

Linked to menstrual cycle.en: A chill in the afternoon that is related to the menstrual period.
Linked to menstrual cycle.hi: दोपहर बाद माहवारी के समय ठंड लगती है।
Linked to menstrual cycle.roman: dophar baad mahwari ke samay thandi lagti hai.

Linked to menstrual cycle.en: A chill that comes on in the afternoon during the menstrual period.
Linked to menstrual cycle.hi: माहवारी के दौरान दोपहर बाद कंपकंपी आती है।
Linked to menstrual cycle.roman: mahwari ke dauran dophar baad kampkampi aati hai.

Linked to menstrual cycle.path: Chill, afternoon, menses, first day of
Linked to menstrual cycle.en: A chill that comes on in the afternoon on the first day of the menstrual period.
Linked to menstrual cycle.hi: माहवारी के पहले दिन दोपहर बाद ठंड लगती है।
Linked to menstrual cycle.roman: mahwari ke pehle din dophar baad thandi lagti hai.

Triggered by specific actions.en: A chill that comes on in the afternoon after going for a walk.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: दोपहर बाद पैदल चलने के बाद ठंड लगने लगती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: dophar baad paidel chalne ke baad thandi lagni lagti hai.

Triggered by weather/temperature.path: Chill, afternoon, warm room, even in a
Triggered by weather/temperature.en: A chill that comes on in the afternoon even when sitting in a warm room.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: दोपहर बाद गर्म कमरे में रहने पर भी ठंड लगती है।
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: dophar baad garam kamre mein rahne par bhi thandi lagti hai.

Triggered by weather/temperature.path: Chill, air, cold air
Triggered by weather/temperature.en: A chilly feeling triggered by cold air.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: ठंडी हवा लगने से कंपकंपी होती है।
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: thandi hawa lagne se kampkampi hoti hai.

Triggered by weather/temperature.path: Chill, air, cold air, from a warm room
Triggered by weather/temperature.en: A chilly feeling triggered by stepping from a warm room into cold air.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: गर्म कमरे से निकलकर ठंडी हवा में आने पर कंपकंपी होती है।
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: garam kamre se niklkar thandi hawa mein aane par kampkampi hoti hai.

Triggered by weather/temperature.path: Chill, air, cold air, on going into the
Triggered by weather/temperature.en: A chilly feeling that comes on when going out into cold air.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: ठंडी हवा में बाहर जाने पर ठंड लगने लगती है।
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: thandi hawa mein bahar jane par thandi lagni lagti hai.

Triggered by weather/temperature.path: Chill, air, in the open
Triggered by weather/temperature.en: A chilly feeling that comes on when out in the open air (general).
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: खुली हवा में रहने से ठंड लगती है।
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: khuli hawa mein rehne se thandi lagti hai.

Triggered by weather/temperature.path: Chill, air, in the open agg.
Triggered by weather/temperature.en: A chilly feeling that gets worse when out in the open air.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: खुली हवा में जाने से ठंड और बढ़ जाती है।
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: khuli hawa mein jane se thandi aur badh jati hai.

Triggered by weather/temperature.path: Chill, air, in the open, amel.
Triggered by weather/temperature.en: A chilly feeling that gets better when out in the open air.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: खुली हवा में जाने से ठंड में आराम मिलता है।
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: khuli hawa mein jane se thandi mein aaram milta hai.

Triggered by weather/temperature.path: Chill, air, in the open, exercise in, amel.
Triggered by weather/temperature.en: A chilly feeling that gets better when exercising in the open air.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: खुली हवा में व्यायाम करने से ठंड में राहत मिलती है।
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: khuli hawa mein vyayam karne se thandi mein rahat milti hai.

Triggered by weather/temperature.path: Chill, air, the least draft of
Triggered by weather/temperature.en: A chilly feeling brought on by even the slightest draft of air.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: हल्की सी हवा का झोंका लगते ही ठंड लगने लगती है।
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: halki si hawa ka jhonka lagte hi thandi lagne lagti hai.

Triggered by weather/temperature.path: Chill, air, warm air, feels cold
Triggered by weather/temperature.en: Even in warm air outside, you still feel cold.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: गर्म हवा में भी ठंड का एहसास होता है।
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: garm hawa mein bhi thandi ka ehsaas hota hai.

Triggered by specific actions.path: Chill, air, walking in the open air
Triggered by specific actions.en: You feel chilly while walking outside in the open air.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: खुली हवा में चलने से ठंड लगती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: khuli hawa mein chalne se thandi lagti hai.

Triggered by specific actions.path: Chill, air, walking in the open air, after
Triggered by specific actions.en: You feel chilly after walking outside in the open air.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: खुली हवा में चलने के बाद ठंड लगने लगती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: khuli hawa mein chalne ke baad thandi lagne lagti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: You get a chill that returns every six months, at the same time each year.
Linked to time of day.hi: हर छह महीने में एक बार ठंड का दौरा पड़ता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: har chhah mahine mein ek baar thandi ka daura padta hai.

General.path: Chill, anticipating, about 2 hours each attack
General.en: Your chills come on earlier each time, with each attack arriving about 2 hours sooner than the last.
General.hi: ठंड का दौरा हर बार तय समय से लगभग 2 घंटे पहले आता है।
General.roman: thandi ka daura har baar tay samay se lagbhag 2 ghante pehle aata hai.

General.path: Chill, anticipating, every
General.en: Your chills keep coming back on a regular repeating schedule, each time a little earlier than before.
General.hi: ठंड का दौरा हर बार पहले से पहले आता जाता है।
General.roman: thandi ka daura har baar pehle se pehle aata jata hai.

General.path: Chill, anticipating, or postponing
General.en: Your chills either come earlier than expected or are delayed and arrive later than expected.
General.hi: ठंड का दौरा कभी पहले आता है तो कभी देर से।
General.roman: Thandi ka daura kabhi pehle aata hai to kabhi der se.

Linked to time of day.en: Your chills come back every day, starting about 2 hours earlier each time.
Linked to time of day.hi: ठंड का दौरा हर दिन 2 घंटे पहले आने लगता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: thandi ka daura har din 2 ghante pehle aane lagta hai.

Linked to eating/digestion.en: Eating makes the chilly feeling better afterwards.
Linked to eating/digestion.hi: खाने के बाद ठंड में आराम मिलता है।
Linked to eating/digestion.roman: Khane ke baad thandi mein aaram milta hai.

Linked to eating/digestion.en: Eating the wrong foods or overeating brings on a chilly feeling.
Linked to eating/digestion.hi: गलत या बाहरी खाना खाने से ठंड लगती है।
Linked to eating/digestion.roman: Galat ya bahari khana khane se thandi lagti hai.

Linked to eating/digestion.en: Eating warm foods makes the chilly feeling worse.
Linked to eating/digestion.hi: गर्म चीज़ें खाने से ठंड और बढ़ जाती है।
Linked to eating/digestion.roman: Garm cheezein khane se thandi aur badh jati hai.

Linked to eating/digestion.en: A chilly feeling that comes on while eating.
Linked to eating/digestion.hi: खाते समय ठंड लगती है।
Linked to eating/digestion.roman: Khate samay thandi lagti hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Chill, evening, 7 p.m., as though dashed with ice-cold water, or as if the blood were running cold through the blood vessels, cold when he moves, increased by eating and drinking
Linked to time of day.en: At around 7 p.m., a chilly feeling as though cold water has been thrown over the body, or as if cold blood is running through the veins; the chilliness gets worse with movement and is made even worse by eating or drinking.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम को 7 बजे ऐसा लगता है जैसे बर्फ जैसा ठंडा पानी डाल दिया हो या जैसे नसों में ठंडा खून दौड़ रहा हो, हिलने-डुलने पर ठंड और बढ़ जाती है और खाने-पीने से भी ठंड बढ़ती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Shaam ko 7 baje aisa lagta hai jaise barf jaisa thanda pani daal diya ho ya jaise nason mein thanda khun daur raha ho, hilne-dulne par thandi aur badh jati hai aur khane-pine se bhi thandi badhti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: You feel chilly in the evening around the time you fall asleep or are sleeping.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम को नींद आने के समय ठंड लगती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Shaam ko nind aane ke samay thandi lagti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: You feel chilly in the evening just before you fall asleep.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम को नींद आने से पहले ठंड लगती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Shaam ko nind aane se pehle thandi lagti hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Chill, evening, asleep, on falling asleep
Linked to time of day.en: You feel chilly in the evening at the moment you fall asleep.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम को जब नींद आती है तो उसी वक्त ठंड लगने लगती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Shaam ko jab nind aati hai to usi waqt thandi lagne lagti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: You feel chilly in the evening when you get into bed.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम को बिस्तर पर जाने पर ठंड लगती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Shaam ko bistar par jane par thandi lagti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: You feel chilly starting in the evening and it continues until midnight.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम को ठंड लगती है जो आधी रात तक बनी रहती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Shaam ko thandi lagti hai jo aadhi raat tak bani rehti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: You feel chilly starting in the evening and the chilliness lasts all night long.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम को ठंड लगती है जो पूरी रात भर बनी रहती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Shaam ko thandi lagti hai jo puri raat bhar bani rehti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: You feel chilly in the evening and no feeling of heat follows afterwards.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम को ठंड लगती है लेकिन बाद में बुखार नहीं होता।
Linked to time of day.roman: Sham ko thand lagti hai lekin baad mein bukhar nahi hota.

Linked to time of day.en: You feel chilly in the evening around or just after sunset.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम को सूरज डूबने के समय ठंड लगती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Sham ko suraj dubne ke samay thand lagti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: You feel chilly in the evening when you wake up.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम को नींद से जागने पर ठंड लगती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Sham ko nind se jagne par thand lagti hai.

Comes with other symptoms.path: Chill, evening, abdomen, with burning in the
Comes with other symptoms.en: You feel chilly in the evening, and at the same time your belly feels like it's burning inside.

Comes with other symptoms.roman: Shaam ko thandi lagti hai aur sath mein pet mein jalan bhi hoti hai.

Comes with other symptoms.path: Chill, evening, colic, with
Comes with other symptoms.en: You feel chilly in the evening and at the same time you have cramping pains in your belly.

Comes with other symptoms.roman: Shaam ko thandi lagti hai aur sath mein pet mein marod bhi hoti hai.

Comes with other symptoms.path: Chill, evening, followed by convulsions and heat lasting all night
Comes with other symptoms.en: You feel chilly in the evening, and this is followed by convulsions and a feverish heat that lasts all night.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: शाम को ठंड लगती है जिसके बाद दौरे (ऐंठन) पड़ते हैं और फिर गर्मी पूरी रात बनी रहती है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: Sham ko thand lagti hai jiske baad daure (ainthan) padte hain aur phir garmi puri raat bani rahti hai.

Comes with other symptoms.path: Chill, evening, followed, by sweat
Comes with other symptoms.en: You feel chilly in the evening, and sweating follows the chills.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: शाम को ठंड लगती है और उसके बाद पसीना आता है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: Sham ko thand lagti hai aur uske baad pasina aata hai.

Comes with other symptoms.path: Chill, evening, heat
Comes with other symptoms.en: You feel chilly in the evening, and this is followed by or accompanied by a feeling of heat.

Comes with other symptoms.roman: Sham ko thand lagti hai aur saath mein bukhar bhi hota hai.

Comes with other symptoms.path: Chill, evening, heat, with flushes of
Comes with other symptoms.en: You feel chilly in the evening along with sudden waves or flushes of heat.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: शाम को ठंड लगती है और साथ में अचानक गर्मी की लहरें भी आती हैं।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: Sham ko thand lagti hai aur saath mein achanak garmi ki lahren bhi aati hain.

Comes with other symptoms.path: Chill, evening, mingled with heat, then heat no sweat
Comes with other symptoms.en: You feel chilly and hot mixed together in the evening, and then heat comes without any sweating.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: शाम को ठंड और गर्मी मिली-जुली रहती है, फिर सिर्फ गर्मी होती है लेकिन पसीना नहीं आता।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: Sham ko thand aur garmi mili-juli rhti hai, phir sirf garmi hoti hai lekin pasina nahi aata.

Comes with other symptoms.path: Chill, evening, pains with the
Comes with other symptoms.en: You feel chilly in the evening and you have pains along with the chills.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: शाम को ठंड लगती है और साथ में दर्द भी होता है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: Sham ko thand lagti hai aur saath mein dard bhi hota hai.

Comes with other symptoms.path: Chill, evening, sleep, with stupefying
Comes with other symptoms.en: You feel chilly in the evening and at the same time you feel drowsy and heavy-headed.

Comes with other symptoms.roman: Sham ko thand lagti hai aur saath mein bhari nind bhi aati hai.

Linked to posture/position.roman: Shaam ko bistar par jane se thandi kam ho jati hai.

Linked to posture/position.roman: Sham ko letne ke baad thand lagne lagti hai.

Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: Shaam ko bahari thandi lagne se kampakampi shuru ho jati hai.

Triggered by weather/temperature.en: You feel chilly in the evening even when you are in a warm room.

Triggered by weather/temperature.en: You feel chilly in the evening while being warmed from outside your body.

Triggered by weather/temperature.en: You feel chilly in the evening and external warmth does not relieve the chilliness.

Triggered by specific actions.roman: Sham ko chalne-phirne par thand lagti hai.

Triggered by specific actions.hi: शाम को उठने पर ठंड लगने लगती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Sham ko uthne par thand lagne lagti hai.

Triggered by specific actions.en: You feel chilly in the evening when you undress or take your clothes off.

Triggered by specific actions.roman: Sham ko kapde utarte samay thand lagti hai.

Triggered by specific actions.en: You feel chilly in the evening while walking.

Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: Thandi hawa ke jhonke ke sampark mein aane se thandi lagti hai.

Triggered by weather/temperature.en: You get chills after being in a draft of air when your body was already heated up.

Triggered by weather/temperature.path: Chill, exposure, wet, from becoming

Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: Gile mausam mein bhigne se thandi lag jati hai.

Triggered by specific actions.path: Chill, exposure, cold bathing, too frequent

Triggered by specific situations.hi: पानी के पास या नदी-नाले के किनारे रहने से ठंड लगती है।
Triggered by specific situations.roman: Pani ke paas ya nadi-nale ke kinare rehne se thandi lagti hai.

Triggered by specific situations.hi: मलेरिया जैसे बुखार के प्रभाव से ठंड लगती है।
Triggered by specific situations.roman: Malaria jaise bukhar ke prabhaav se thandi lagti hai.

Triggered by specific situations.en: You tend to get chills from living or spending time at the seaside.
Triggered by specific situations.hi: समुद्र के किनारे रहने से ठंड लगती है।
Triggered by specific situations.roman: Samudra ke kinare rehne se thandi lagti hai.

Linked to time of day.hi: शाम को बाहर से ठंड लगती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Shaam ko bahar se thandi lagti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: You feel cold on the outside of your body in the evening while in bed.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम को बिस्तर में बाहर से ठंड लगती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Shaam ko bistar mein bahar se thandi lagti hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Chill, external, evening, lasting until 4 a.m.
Linked to time of day.en: You feel cold on the outside of your body in the evening, and it lasts until 4 in the morning.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम को बाहर से ठंड लगती है जो रात के चार बजे तक बनी रहती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Shaam ko bahar se thandi lagti hai jo raat ke char baje tak bani rahti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: You feel cold on the outside of your body in the morning.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह बाहर से ठंड लगती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah bahar se thandi lagti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: You feel cold on the outside of your body at night.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को बाहर से ठंड लगती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko bahar se thandi lagti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: You feel cold on the outside of your body while sleeping at night.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को नींद के दौरान बाहर से ठंड लगती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko nind ke dauran bahar se thandi lagti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: You feel cold on the outside of your body at night after waking up.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को जागने के बाद बाहर से ठंड लगती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko jagne ke baad bahar se thandi lagti hai.

General sensation.en: You feel a severe external coldness over your body, like what happens in cholera.
General sensation.hi: हैजे जैसी बाहरी ठंड लगती है।
General sensation.roman: Haje jaisi bahari thandi lagti hai.

General sensation.path: Chill, external, lasting 36 hours, with thirst, without desire for warmth or dread of open air, without subsequent heat
General sensation.en: You feel cold on the outside of your body for about 36 hours, with thirst, but without wanting warmth or fearing fresh air, and with no feeling of heat afterwards.
General sensation.hi: 36 घंटे तक बाहर से ठंड लगती है, साथ में प्यास लगती है, न गर्मी की इच्छा होती है और न खुली हवा से डर, और बाद में बुखार भी नहीं आता।
General sensation.roman: 36 ghante tak bahar se thandi lagti hai, sath mein pyas lagti hai, na garmi ki ichchha hoti hai aur na khuli hawa se dar, aur baad mein bukhar bhi nahi ata.

Comes with other symptoms.path: Chill, external, sensation as if the hair were standing on end, with
Comes with other symptoms.en: You feel cold on the outside of your body and it feels as if the hairs on your skin are standing on end.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: बाहर से ठंड लगती है और ऐसा लगता है जैसे रोंगटे खड़े हो गए हों।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: Bahar se thandi lagti hai aur aisa lagta hai jaise rongte khde ho gaye hon.

Comes with other symptoms.path: Chill, external, stupor, during
Comes with other symptoms.en: You feel cold on the outside of your body while feeling drowsy or in a stupor.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: बेहोशी या सुस्ती की हालत में बाहर से ठंड लगती है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: Behoshi ya sussti ki halat mein bahar se thandi lagti hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Chill, external, spots, in
Sensation / feel of the area.en: You feel cold on the outside of your body in certain patches or spots rather than all over.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: बाहर से ठंड कुछ खास जगहों पर लगती है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Bahar se thandi kuch khas jagahon par lagti hai.

Linked to bowel movement.path: Chill, external, stool, during desire for
Linked to bowel movement.en: You feel cold on the outside of your body when you feel the urge to have a bowel movement.
Linked to bowel movement.hi: शौच की इच्छा होने पर बाहर से ठंड लगती है।
Linked to bowel movement.roman: Shauch ki ichchha hone par bahar se thandi lagti hai.

Triggered by specific actions.en: You feel cold on the outside of your body whenever you uncover or expose any part of your body.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: कपड़ा हटाने या उघाड़ने पर बाहर से ठंड लगती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Kapda hatane ya ugharne par bahar se thandi lagti hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Chill, forenoon, 10 a.m., lasting until 5 p.m.
Linked to time of day.en: You feel chilly starting at 10 in the morning and it lasts until 5 in the afternoon.
Linked to time of day.hi: पूर्वाह्न सुबह दस बजे ठंड लगती है जो शाम पाँच बजे तक बनी रहती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Purvahn subah das baje thandi lagti hai jo shaam paanch baje tak bani rahti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: You feel chilly in the morning and it continues until 5 in the afternoon.
Linked to time of day.hi: पूर्वाह्न में ठंड लगती है जो शाम पाँच बजे तक बनी रहती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Purvahn mein thandi lagti hai jo shaam paanch baje tak bani rahti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: You feel chilly in the morning while you are sleeping.
Linked to time of day.hi: पूर्वाह्न में नींद के दौरान ठंड लगती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Purvahn mein neend ke dauran thandi lagti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: You feel chilly in the morning when you wake up.
Linked to time of day.hi: पूर्वाह्न में नींद से जागने पर ठंड लगती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Purvahn mein neend se jaagne par thandi lagti hai.

Comes with other symptoms.path: Chill, forenoon, 11 a.m., with disgust at even the smell of food
Comes with other symptoms.en: You feel chilly at 11 in the morning, and at the same time even the smell of food makes you feel disgusted.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: पूर्वाह्न ग्यारह बजे ठंड लगती है और खाने की गंध से भी घिन्न आती है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: Purvahn gyarah baje thandi lagti hai aur khane ki gandh se bhi ghin aati hai.

Comes with other symptoms.path: Chill, forenoon, sudden chill, with goose flesh and hair standing on end
Comes with other symptoms.en: You suddenly feel chilly in the morning, with goosebumps and your hairs standing on end.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: पूर्वाह्न में अचानक तेज़ ठंड लगती है और रोंगटे खड़े हो जाते हैं।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: Purvahn mein achanak tez thandi lagti hai aur rongte khde ho jate hain.

Triggered by weather/temperature.path: Chill, forenoon, hot room, in a
Triggered by weather/temperature.en: You feel chilly in the morning even when you are in a warm room.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: पूर्वाह्न में गर्म कमरे में रहने पर भी ठंड लगती है।
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: Purvahn mein garam kamre mein rehne par bhi thandi lagti hai.

Triggered by weather/temperature.path: Chill, forenoon, warm stove, by a
Triggered by weather/temperature.en: You feel chilly in the morning even when sitting next to a warm stove.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: पूर्वाह्न में गर्म चूल्हे या हीटर के पास बैठने पर भी ठंड लगती है।
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: Purvahn mein garam chulhe ya heater ke pas baithne par bhi thandi lagti hai.

Linked to bowel movement.en: You feel chilly in the morning after having a bowel movement.
Linked to bowel movement.hi: पूर्वाह्न में शौच के बाद ठंड लगती है।
Linked to bowel movement.roman: Purvahn mein shauch ke baad thandi lagti hai.

General sensation.path: Chill, icy coldness of the body, as if lying on ice
General sensation.en: Your whole body feels so icy cold it is as if you are lying on ice.
General sensation.hi: ऐसा लगता है जैसे बर्फ पर लेटे हों, इतनी ठंड लगती है।
General sensation.roman: Aisa lagta hai jaise barf par lete hon, itni thandi lagti hai.

General sensation.path: Chill, icy coldness of the body, uncover, with desire to
General sensation.en: Your body feels icy cold and you have a strong urge to uncover yourself or take off your covers.
General sensation.hi: पूरे शरीर में बर्फ जैसी ठंड लगती है लेकिन कपड़े हटाने की इच्छा होती है।
General sensation.roman: Pure sharir mein barf jaisi thandi lagti hai lekin kapde hatane ki ichchha hoti hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Chill, icy coldness of the body, in single places
Sensation / feel of the area.en: You feel patches of intense icy coldness in individual spots on your body rather than all over.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: शरीर के किसी एक जगह बर्फ जैसी ठंड महसूस होती है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Sharir ke kisi ek jagah barf jaisi thandi mehsus hoti hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Chill, icy coldness of the body, in, spots
Sensation / feel of the area.en: You feel intense icy coldness in certain spots on your body.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: शरीर पर अलग-अलग छोटी जगहों पर बर्फ जैसी ठंड लगती है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Sharir par alag-alag chhoti jagahon par barf jaisi thandi lagti hai.

Linked to menstrual cycle.path: Chill, icy coldness of the body, menses, during
Linked to menstrual cycle.en: You feel intensely icy cold all over your body during your menstrual period.
Linked to menstrual cycle.hi: माहवारी के दौरान पूरे शरीर में बर्फ जैसी ठंड लगती है।
Linked to menstrual cycle.roman: Mahvari ke dauran pure sharir mein barf jaisi thandi lagti hai.

Comes with other symptoms.path: Chill, icy coldness of the body, of skin and covered with a cold sweat, hands and feet livid
Comes with other symptoms.en: Your skin feels icy cold and is covered in a cold sweat, and your hands and feet look bluish or purple.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: पूरा शरीर बर्फ जैसा ठंडा हो जाता है, त्वचा पर ठंडा पसीना आता है और हाथ-पैर नीले पड़ जाते हैं।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: Pura sharir barf jaisa thanda ho jata hai, tvcha par thanda pasina ata hai aur hath-pair nile pad jate hain.

Comes with other symptoms.path: Chill, icy coldness of the body, of, the whole body, with cold breath
Comes with other symptoms.en: Your whole body feels icy cold, even your breath feels cold.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: पूरे शरीर में बर्फ जैसी ठंड लगती है और मुँह से भी ठंडी सांस निकलती है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: Pure sharir mein barf jaisi thandi lagti hai aur munh se bhi thandi sans nikatti hai.

Comes with other symptoms.path: Chill, icy coldness of the body, skin dry and blue, yet desires to be uncovered
Comes with other symptoms.en: Your skin is dry and looks blue or bluish, yet you still want to be uncovered despite feeling icy cold.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: त्वचा सूखी और नीली हो जाती है लेकिन फिर भी ढकना अच्छा नहीं लगता, खुला रहना चाहता है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: Tvcha sukhi aur nili ho jati hai lekin phir bhi dhakna accha nahi lagta, khula rehna chahta hai.

Comes with other symptoms.path: Chill, icy coldness of the body, with clammy sweat and blueness, cannot bear to be covered
Comes with other symptoms.en: Your body feels icy cold with a clammy sweat and bluish skin colour, and you cannot stand to be covered up.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: पूरे शरीर में बर्फ जैसी ठंड और चिपचिपा पसीना आता है, शरीर नीला पड़ जाता है और ओढ़ना बिल्कुल सहन नहीं होता।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: Pure sharir mein barf jaisi thandi aur chipchipa pasina ata hai, sharir nila pad jata hai aur odhna bilkul sahan nahi hota.

Linked to time of day.en: You feel a cold sensation inside your body in the afternoon.
Linked to time of day.hi: दोपहर बाद अंदर से ठंड लगती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Dopahar baad andar se thandi lagti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: You feel a cold sensation inside your body in the afternoon, coming after a feeling of heat.
Linked to time of day.hi: दोपहर बाद गर्मी के बाद अंदर से ठंड लगती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Dopahar baad garmi ke baad andar se thandi lagti hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Chill, internal, afternoon, without subsequent heat
Linked to time of day.en: You feel a cold sensation inside your body in the afternoon, with no feeling of heat following it.
Linked to time of day.hi: दोपहर बाद अंदर से ठंड लगती है लेकिन बाद में गर्मी नहीं आती।
Linked to time of day.roman: Dopahar baad andar se thandi lagti hai lekin baad mein garmi nahi ati.

Linked to time of day.en: You feel a cold sensation inside your body in the evening.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम को अंदर से ठंड लगती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Sham ko andar se thandi lagti hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Chill, internal, evening, on falling asleep
Linked to time of day.en: You feel a cold sensation inside your body in the evening as you are falling asleep.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम को जब नींद आने लगती है तब अंदर से ठंड लगती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Sham ko jab nind ane lagti hai tab andar se thandi lagti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: You feel a cold sensation inside your body in the late morning.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह के पूर्वार्ध में अंदर से ठंड लगती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah ke purvardh mein andar se thandi lagti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: You feel a cold sensation inside your body in the morning.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह उठने पर अंदर से ठंड लगती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah uthne par andar se thandi lagti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: You feel a cold sensation inside your body in the morning while still in bed.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह बिस्तर में लेटे-लेटे अंदर से ठंड लगती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah bistar mein lete-lete andar se thandi lagti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: You feel a cold sensation inside your body at night.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को अंदर से ठंड लगती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko andar se thandi lagti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: An internal chill that comes on at midnight during the night.
Linked to time of day.hi: आधी रात को अंदर से ठंड लगती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Aadhi raat ko andar se thandi lagti hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Chill, internal, night, sleep, first, during
Linked to time of day.en: An internal chill that comes on during the first part of sleep at night.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को पहली नींद के दौरान अंदर से ठंड लगती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko pehli nind ke dauran andar se thandi lagti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: An internal chill that comes on at night when waking up.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को जागने पर अंदर से ठंड लगती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko jagne par andar se thandi lagti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: An internal chill that comes on at noon.
Linked to time of day.hi: दोपहर को अंदर से ठंड लगती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Dopahar ko andar se thandi lagti hai.

General sensation.en: You feel a general cold sensation inside your body.
General sensation.hi: अंदर से ठंड महसूस होती है।
General sensation.roman: Andar se thandi mehsus hoti hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Chill, internal, coldness, as if in the bones
Sensation / feel of the area.en: You feel as if the coldness is coming from deep inside your bones.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: ऐसा लगता है जैसे हड्डियों के अंदर से ठंड आ रही हो।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Aisa lagta hai jaise haddiyon ke andar se thandi aa rahi ho.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Chill, internal, coldness, in blood vessels
Sensation / feel of the area.en: You feel as if cold is running through your blood vessels inside your body.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: ऐसा लगता है जैसे नसों में ठंडा खून बह रहा हो।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Aisa lagta hai jaise nason mein thanda khun bah raha ho.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Chill, internal, coldness, joints, as if in the
Sensation / feel of the area.en: You feel as if the coldness is coming from deep inside your joints.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: ऐसा लगता है जैसे जोड़ों के अंदर से ठंड आ रही हो।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Aisa lagta hai jaise jodon ke andar se thandi aa rahi ho.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Chill, internal, night, as if cold air were streaming through the bones
Sensation / feel of the area.en: You feel a cold sensation inside your body at night, as if cold air is streaming right through your bones.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: रात को ऐसा लगता है जैसे हड्डियों में से ठंडी हवा बह रही हो।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Raat ko aisa lagta hai jaise haddiyon mein se thandi hawa bah rahi ho.

Linked to posture/position.path: Chill, internal, evening, lying down, agg.
Linked to posture/position.en: You feel a cold sensation inside your body in the evening, and lying down makes it worse.
Linked to posture/position.hi: शाम को लेटने पर अंदर की ठंड बढ़ जाती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Sham ko letne par andar ki thandi badh jati hai.

Triggered by weather/temperature.path: Chill, internal, external heat agg.
Triggered by weather/temperature.en: Your internal coldness is made worse by heat applied from outside your body.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: बाहर से गर्मी लगाने पर अंदर की ठंड और बढ़ जाती है।
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: Bahar se garmi lagne par andar ki thandi aur badh jati hai.

Triggered by weather/temperature.path: Chill, internal, night, warm room, in a
Triggered by weather/temperature.en: An internal chill that comes on at night even while in a warm room.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: रात को गर्म कमरे में रहने पर भी अंदर से ठंड लगती है।
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: Raat ko garam kamre mein rehne par bhi andar se thandi lagti hai.

Linked to eating/digestion.en: You feel a cold sensation inside your body in the morning during breakfast.
Linked to eating/digestion.hi: सुबह नाश्ते के समय अंदर से ठंड लगती है।
Linked to eating/digestion.roman: Subah nashte ke samay andar se thandi lagti hai.

Triggered by specific actions.path: Chill, internal, night, open air, in
Triggered by specific actions.en: An internal chill that comes on at night when going out into the open air.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: रात को खुली हवा में अंदर से ठंड लगती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Raat ko khuli hava mein andar se thandi lagti hai.

Linked to posture/position.path: Chill, lying, after, amel.
Linked to posture/position.en: The chills get better after lying down for a while.
Linked to posture/position.hi: लेटने के बाद ठंड कम हो जाती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Letne ke baad thandi kam ho jati hai.

Linked to posture/position.path: Chill, lying, amel.
Linked to posture/position.en: The chills get better when lying down.
Linked to posture/position.hi: लेटने पर ठंड कम हो जाती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Letne par thandi kam ho jati hai.

Linked to posture/position.path: Chill, lying, while agg.
Linked to posture/position.en: The chills get worse while lying down.
Linked to posture/position.hi: लेटे रहने पर ठंड बढ़ जाती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Lete rehne par thandi badh jati hai.

Linked to menstrual cycle.en: Chills that come on after the menstrual period has ended.
Linked to menstrual cycle.hi: माहवारी के बाद ठंड लगती है।
Linked to menstrual cycle.roman: Mahwari ke baad thandi lagti hai.

Linked to menstrual cycle.en: Chills that come on before the menstrual period starts.
Linked to menstrual cycle.hi: माहवारी से पहले ठंड लगती है।
Linked to menstrual cycle.roman: Mahwari se pehle thandi lagti hai.

Linked to menstrual cycle.en: Chills that occur during the menstrual period.
Linked to menstrual cycle.hi: माहवारी के दौरान ठंड लगती है।
Linked to menstrual cycle.roman: Mahwari ke dauran thandi lagti hai.

Linked to menstrual cycle.en: A constant chill that lasts throughout the entire menstrual period.
Linked to menstrual cycle.hi: माहवारी के दौरान लगातार ठंड लगती रहती है।
Linked to menstrual cycle.roman: Mahwari ke dauran lagatar thandi lagti rehti hai.

Linked to menstrual cycle.en: Chills that come on during the breaks or pauses between menstrual cramps.
Linked to menstrual cycle.hi: माहवारी के बीच के समय में ठंड लगती है।
Linked to menstrual cycle.roman: mahwari ke beech ke samay mein thandi lagti hai.

Linked to menstrual cycle.en: During the menstrual period, chills come on whenever the body is left uncovered.
Linked to menstrual cycle.hi: माहवारी के दौरान कपड़े हटाने पर ठंड लगती है।
Linked to menstrual cycle.roman: mahwari ke dauran kapde hatane par thandi lagti hai.

Linked to menstrual cycle.en: During the menstrual period, chills come on while walking.
Linked to menstrual cycle.hi: माहवारी के दौरान चलने पर ठंड लगती है।
Linked to menstrual cycle.roman: mahwari ke dauran chalne par thandi lagti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A chill that comes on after midnight.
Linked to time of day.hi: आधी रात के बाद ठंड लगती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: aadhi raat ke baad thandi lagti hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Chill, midnight, after, frequent chills from 1 to 7 a.m.
Linked to time of day.en: Frequent chills occurring repeatedly between 1 a.m. and 7 a.m., starting after midnight.
Linked to time of day.hi: आधी रात के बाद रात एक बजे से सात बजे तक बार-बार ठंड लगती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: aadhi raat ke baad raat ek baje se saat baje tak baar-baar thandi lagti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A chill that comes on just before midnight.
Linked to time of day.hi: आधी रात से पहले ठंड लगती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: aadhi raat se pehle thandi lagti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A chill that comes on at 3 a.m. upon waking.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह तीन बजे जागने पर ठंड लगती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: subah teen baje jagne par thandi lagti hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Chill, morning, 4 a.m., followed by sweat
Linked to time of day.en: A chill that comes on at 4 a.m. and is followed by sweating.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह चार बजे ठंड लगती है और उसके बाद पसीना आता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: subah char baje thandi lagti hai aur uske baad pasina aata hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Chill, morning, 5 a.m., after 36 hours' fever
Linked to time of day.en: A chill that comes on at 5 a.m., appearing after 36 hours of fever.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह पाँच बजे ठंड लगती है, यह छत्तीस घंटे बुखार रहने के बाद होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: subah paanch baje thandi lagti hai, yeh chhatees ghante bukhar rahne ke baad hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A chill that comes on in the morning while still in bed.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह बिस्तर में ठंड लगती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: subah bistar mein thandi lagti hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Chill, morning, continuing through the forenoon
Linked to time of day.en: A morning chill that continues on through the late morning hours.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह से शुरू होकर ठंड पूरे पहले पहर तक बनी रहती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: subah se shuru hokar thandi pure pehle phar tak bani rahti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A morning chill that continues all the way through until evening.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह से शुरू होकर ठंड शाम तक बनी रहती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: subah se shuru hokar thandi shaam tak bani rahti hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Chill, morning, heavy chill morning of one day, light in afternoon of next
Linked to time of day.en: A pattern where a heavy chill comes on one morning, then only a light chill appears the following afternoon.
Linked to time of day.hi: एक दिन सुबह तेज ठंड लगती है और अगले दिन दोपहर बाद हल्की ठंड लगती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: ek din subah tej thandi lagti hai aur agle din dopahar baad halki thandi lagti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A morning chill that comes on after a nocturnal emission during sleep.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को स्वप्नदोष के बाद सुबह ठंड लगती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: raat ko swapandosh ke baad subah thandi lagti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A morning chill that comes on after sweating.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह पसीना आने के बाद ठंड लगती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: subah pasina aane ke baad thandi lagti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A morning chill that comes on after getting up.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह उठने के बाद ठंड लगती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: subah uthne ke baad thandi lagti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A chill that comes on during sleep in the morning.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह नींद के दौरान ठंड लगती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: subah nind ke dauran thandi lagti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: In the morning, a chill comes on whenever the body is left uncovered.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह कपड़े हटाने पर ठंड लगती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: subah kapde hatane par thandi lagti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A chill that comes on in the morning upon waking.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह जागने पर ठंड लगती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: subah jaagne par thandi lagti hai.

Linked to eating/digestion.en: A morning chill connected to breakfast time.
Linked to eating/digestion.hi: सुबह नाश्ते के समय ठंड लगती है।
Linked to eating/digestion.roman: subah nashte ke samay thandi lagti hai.

Linked to eating/digestion.en: A chill that comes on in the morning after eating breakfast.
Linked to eating/digestion.hi: सुबह नाश्ते के बाद ठंड लगती है।
Linked to eating/digestion.roman: subah nashte ke baad thandi lagti hai.

Linked to eating/digestion.en: A chill that comes on in the morning while eating breakfast.
Linked to eating/digestion.hi: सुबह नाश्ते के दौरान ठंड लगती है।
Linked to eating/digestion.roman: subah nashte ke dauran thandi lagti hai.

Linked to menstrual cycle.path: Chill, morning, menses, during, after faintness
Linked to menstrual cycle.en: During the menstrual period, a morning chill comes on following a feeling of faintness.
Linked to menstrual cycle.hi: माहवारी के दौरान सुबह बेहोशी के बाद ठंड लगती है।
Linked to menstrual cycle.roman: mahwari ke dauran subah behoshi ke baad thandi lagti hai.

Triggered by weather/temperature.path: Chill, morning, warm stove, by a
Triggered by weather/temperature.en: In the morning, a chill comes on when standing near a warm stove.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: सुबह गर्म अंगीठी के पास बैठने पर ठंड लगती है।
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: subah garm angthi ke paas baithne par thandi lagti hai.

Triggered by specific actions.en: A chill that comes on after moving around.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: हिलने-डुलने के बाद ठंड लगती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: hilne-dulne ke baad thandi lagti hai.

Triggered by specific actions.en: The chills get better with movement.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: हिलने-डुलने से ठंड कम हो जाती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: hilne-dulne se thandi kam ho jati hai.

Triggered by specific actions.en: The chills get worse during movement.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: हिलने-डुलने के दौरान ठंड बढ़ जाती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: hilne-dulne ke dauran thandi badh jati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A chill that comes on at night while in bed.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को बिस्तर में ठंड लगती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: raat ko bistar mein thandi lagti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A chill at night that comes on after feeling nauseous.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को उल्टी जैसा महसूस होने के बाद ठंड लगती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: raat ko ulti jaisa mehsus hone ke baad thandi lagti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: Chills that never occur at night.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को ठंड कभी नहीं लगती।
Linked to time of day.roman: raat ko thandi kabhi nahi lagti.

Linked to time of day.en: A chill that comes on at night upon waking.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को जागने पर ठंड लगती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko jaagne par thandi lagti hai.

Comes with other symptoms.path: Chill, night, hot head, with
Comes with other symptoms.en: A nighttime chill that comes along with a hot head.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: रात को ठंड लगती है और साथ में सिर गर्म रहता है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: raat ko thandi lagti hai aur saath mein sir garm rehta hai.

Comes with other symptoms.path: Chill, night, sweat, during
Comes with other symptoms.en: A chill that occurs at night along with sweating.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: रात को पसीने के साथ ठंड लगती है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: raat ko pasine ke saath thandi lagti hai.

Triggered by specific actions.path: Chill, night, putting hand out of bed, on
Triggered by specific actions.en: A nighttime chill that comes on when putting a hand out of bed.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: रात को बिस्तर से हाथ बाहर निकालने पर ठंड लगती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: raat ko bistar se hath bahar nikalne par thandi lagti hai.

Triggered by specific actions.en: A nighttime chill that comes on when getting up.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: रात को उठने पर ठंड लगती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: raat ko uthne par thandi lagti hai.

Triggered by weather/temperature.path: Chill, night, room, warm, in a
Triggered by weather/temperature.en: A nighttime chill that occurs even while in a warm room.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: रात को गर्म कमरे में भी ठंड लगती है।
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: raat ko garm kamre mein bhi thandi lagti hai.

Triggered by specific actions.en: A chill that comes on at noon after bathing.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: दोपहर को नहाने के बाद ठंड लगती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Dopahar ko nahane ke baad thandi lagti hai.

Linked to eating/digestion.en: A chill that comes on at noon after eating dinner.
Linked to eating/digestion.hi: दोपहर को खाना खाने के बाद ठंड लगती है।
Linked to eating/digestion.roman: Dopahar ko khana khane ke baad thandi lagti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A noon chill that is followed by a feeling of heat.
Linked to time of day.hi: दोपहर को ठंड लगती है और उसके बाद गर्मी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Dopahar ko thandi lagti hai aur uske baad garmi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A noon chill that comes on after sleeping.
Linked to time of day.hi: दोपहर की नींद के बाद ठंड लगती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Dopahar ki neend ke baad thandi lagti hai.

General.path: Chill, periodicity, clock-like
General.en: The chills return at almost exactly the same time each day, like clockwork.
General.hi: ठंड बिल्कुल घड़ी की तरह एक तय समय पर आती है।
General.roman: Thandi bilkul ghadi ki tarah ek tay samay par aati hai.

General.path: Chill, periodicity, irregular
General.en: The chills return at irregular, unpredictable intervals.
General.hi: ठंड का दौरा कभी जल्दी, कभी देर से, बेतरतीब तरीके से आता है।
General.roman: Thandi ka daura kabhi jaldi, kabhi der se, betartib tarike se ata hai.

General.path: Chill, periodicity, not marked
General.en: The chills do not follow any clear repeating pattern.
General.hi: ठंड का दौरा तो आता है लेकिन कोई खास नियम नहीं है कब आएगा।
General.roman: Thandi ka daura to ata hai lekin koi khas niyam nahi hai kab aega.

General.path: Chill, periodicity, regular and distinct
General.en: The chills return at clearly regular and predictable intervals.
General.hi: ठंड का दौरा बिल्कुल नियमित और साफ तौर पर एक ही समय पर आता है।
General.roman: Thandi ka daura bilkul niyamit aur saf taur par ek hi samay par ata hai.

Comes with other symptoms.path: Chill, pernicious, violent congestion of head, cold body, with thirst, chill felt most severely in pit of stomach, body feels bruised
Comes with other symptoms.en: A severe dangerous chill with violent rush of blood to the head, the body feeling cold, strong thirst, the worst chilliness felt deep in the pit of the stomach, and the body feeling bruised all over.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: ठंड का बहुत खतरनाक दौरा आता है जिसमें सिर में जोर से खून चढ़ता है, शरीर ठंडा रहता है, प्यास लगती है, पेट के ऊपरी हिस्से में ठंड सबसे ज्यादा महसूस होती है और पूरा शरीर चोट खाया-सा दर्द करता है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: Thandi ka bahut khatarnak daura ata hai jisme sir me jor se khun chadta hai, sharir thanda rahta hai, pyas lagti hai, pet ke uparli hisse me thandi sabse zyada mehsus hoti hai aur pura sharir chot khaya-sa dard karta hai.

Comes with other symptoms.path: Chill, pernicious, violent congestion, suffocation in warm room, chill beginning in chest
Comes with other symptoms.en: A severe dangerous chill that starts in the chest, with violent rush of blood to the head and a feeling of suffocation in a warm room.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: ठंड का बहुत खतरनाक दौरा आता है जिसमें गर्म कमरे में सांस घुटती है और ठंड छाती से शुरू होती है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: Thandi ka bahut khatarnak daura ata hai jisme garam kamre me sans ghutti hai aur thandi chhati se shuru hoti hai.

Comes with other symptoms.path: Chill, pernicious, with red face, delirium and bursting headache, pale face when lying down, red when sitting up
Comes with other symptoms.en: A severe dangerous chill where the face is red and flushed with wild confusion and a bursting headache, but the face goes pale when lying down and turns red again when sitting up.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: ठंड के साथ चेहरा लाल हो जाता है, बेहोशी जैसी बड़बड़ाहट और सिर फटने जैसा दर्द होता है, लेटने पर चेहरा पीला और उठकर बैठने पर लाल हो जाता है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: Thandi ke saath chehra lal ho jata hai, behoshi jaisi badbadahat aur sir fatne jaisa dard hota hai, letne par chehra pila aur uthkar baitne par lal ho jata hai.

Comes with other symptoms.path: Chill, perspiration, with
Comes with other symptoms.en: Chills that come on along with sweating.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: ठंड के साथ-साथ पसीना भी आता है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: Thandi ke saath-saath pasina bhi ata hai.

Comes with other symptoms.path: Chill, perspiration, with, chill, after
Comes with other symptoms.en: Sweating that comes on after the chill, following the chilly phase.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: ठंड के बाद पसीना आता है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: Thandi ke baad pasina ata hai.

Comes with other symptoms.path: Chill, perspiration, with, the more he sweats the colder he becomes
Comes with other symptoms.en: The more sweating occurs, the colder the body feels.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: जितना ज्यादा पसीना आता है उतनी ज्यादा ठंड लगती है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: Jitna zyada pasina ata hai utni zyada thandi lagti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: In the afternoon, the chilly feeling is the strongest part of what is felt.
Linked to time of day.hi: दोपहर बाद ठंड का दौरा सबसे ज्यादा और तेज होता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Dopahar baad thandi ka daura sabse zyada aur tej hota hai.

Linked to time of day.en: In the evening, the chilly feeling is the strongest part of what is felt.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम को ठंड का दौरा सबसे ज्यादा और तेज होता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Shaam ko thandi ka daura sabse zyada aur tej hota hai.

Linked to time of day.en: In the morning, the chilly feeling is the dominant part of what is felt.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह ठंड का दौरा सबसे ज्यादा और तेज होता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah thandi ka daura sabse zyada aur tej hota hai.

Linked to time of day.en: At night, the chilly feeling is the dominant part of what is felt.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को ठंड का दौरा सबसे ज्यादा और तेज होता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko thandi ka daura sabse zyada aur tej hota hai.

Linked to time of day.en: At noon, the chilly feeling is the dominant part of what is felt.
Linked to time of day.hi: दोपहर को ठंड का दौरा सबसे ज्यादा और तेज होता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Dopahar ko thandi ka daura sabse zyada aur tej hota hai.

General.path: Chill, predominating, long lasting chill without heat, sweat or thirst
General.en: A long-lasting chill with no fever, no sweating, and no thirst following it.
General.hi: बहुत देर तक ठंड लगती रहती है, बुखार नहीं आता, पसीना नहीं होता, प्यास भी नहीं लगती।
General.roman: Bahut der tak thandi lagti rahti hai, bukhar nahi aata, pasina nahi hota, pyas bhi nahi lagti.

General.path: Chill, predominating, long lasting chill, little heat, no thirst
General.en: A long-lasting chill with very little fever and no thirst.
General.hi: बहुत देर तक ठंड लगती रहती है, थोड़ा-सा बुखार आता है और प्यास बिल्कुल नहीं लगती।
General.roman: Bahut der tak thandi lagti rahti hai, thoda-sa bukhar aata hai aur pyas bilkul nahi lagti.

General.path: Chill, predominating, the paroxysm consists only of chill
General.en: The entire episode consists only of chills, with no fever or sweating following.
General.hi: ठंड के दौरे में सिर्फ ठंड ही लगती है, बुखार या कुछ और नहीं होता।
General.roman: Thandi ke daure mein sirf thandi hi lagti hai, bukhar ya kuch aur nahi hota.

General.path: Chill, predominating, without heat or thirst
General.en: Chills occur without any fever or thirst.
General.hi: ठंड का दौरा आता है लेकिन बुखार नहीं होता और प्यास भी नहीं लगती।
General.roman: Thandi ka daura aata hai lekin bukhar nahi hota aur pyas bhi nahi lagti.

General.path: Chill, quartan, double
General.en: A double quartan chill pattern where chills repeat in a double cycle every four days.
General.hi: ठंड का दौरा हर चौथे दिन दो बार आता है।
General.roman: Thandi ka daura har chauthe din do baar aata hai.

Comes with other symptoms.path: Chill, quartan, double, with constant diarrhea, on the days free from fever
Comes with other symptoms.en: A double quartan chill repeating every four days, with constant loose bowel movements on the days when there is no fever.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: ठंड का दौरा हर चौथे दिन दो बार आता है और जिन दिनों बुखार नहीं होता उन दिनों लगातार दस्त लगते हैं।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: Thandi ka daura har chauthe din do baar aata hai aur jin dinon bukhar nahi hota un dinon lagatar dast lagte hain.

General.path: Chill, quotidian, double
General.en: A daily chill pattern that occurs twice each day.
General.hi: ठंड का दौरा हर रोज़ दो बार आता है।
General.roman: Thandi ka daura har roz do baar aata hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Chill, quotidian, heavy chill, morning of one day, light chill afternoon of next
Linked to time of day.en: A daily chill pattern where a heavy chill comes one morning and only a light chill comes the following afternoon.
Linked to time of day.hi: एक दिन सुबह तेज ठंड लगती है और अगले दिन दोपहर बाद हल्की ठंड लगती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Ek din subah tej thandi lagti hai aur agle din dopahar baad halki thandi lagti hai.

Linked to posture/position.path: Chill, rising up, amel. on
Linked to posture/position.en: The chills get better when getting up or rising.
Linked to posture/position.hi: उठने पर ठंड कम हो जाती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Uthne par thandi kam ho jati hai.

Linked to posture/position.path: Chill, rising up, on agg.
Linked to posture/position.en: The chills get worse when getting up or rising.
Linked to posture/position.hi: उठने पर ठंड और बढ़ जाती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Uthne par thandi aur badh jati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A shaking chill that comes on in the afternoon.
Linked to time of day.hi: दोपहर बाद कंपकंपी के साथ ठंड लगती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Dopahar baad kampkampi ke saath thandi lagti hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Chill, shaking, afternoon, as if dashed with cold water

Linked to posture/position.roman: Shaam ko bistar par jane se kampkampi aur badh jati hai.

General.path: Chill, shaking, heat, without subsequent, or thirst
General.en: I get a shaking chill that is not followed by heat or thirst afterwards.
General.hi: कंपकंपी होती है लेकिन बाद में न बुखार आता है न प्यास लगती है।

General.path: Chill, shaking, long-lasting
General.en: My shaking chill goes on for a very long time.
General.hi: कंपकंपी बहुत देर तक रहती है।
General.roman: Kampkampi bahut der tak rehti hai.

General.path: Chill, shaking, long-lasting, 12 hours
General.en: My shaking chill lasts for about 12 hours.
General.hi: कंपकंपी लगातार 12 घंटे तक रहती है।
General.roman: Kampkampi lagatar 12 ghante tak rehti hai.

General.path: Chill, shaking, long-lasting, 24 hours, without heat, sweat or thirst
General.en: My shaking chill lasts for about 24 hours and is not followed by heat, sweating, or thirst.
General.hi: कंपकंपी पूरे 24 घंटे रहती है, इस दौरान बुखार नहीं आता, पसीना नहीं होता और प्यास भी नहीं लगती।
General.roman: Kampkampi pure 24 ghante rehti hai, is dauran bukhar nahi aata, pasina nahi hota aur pyaas bhi nahi lagti.

General.path: Chill, shaking, long-lasting, 36 hours, with subsequent heat
General.en: My shaking chill lasts for about 36 hours and is followed by heat afterwards.
General.hi: कंपकंपी 36 घंटे तक रहती है और उसके बाद बुखार आता है।
General.roman: Kampkampi 36 ghante tak rehti hai aur uske baad bukhar aata hai.

General.path: Chill, shaking, long-lasting, little heat, no thirst
General.en: My shaking chill goes on for a long time, with only a little heat and no thirst.
General.hi: कंपकंपी बहुत देर तक रहती है, थोड़ा-सा बुखार होता है और प्यास बिल्कुल नहीं लगती।
General.roman: Kampkampi bahut der tak rehti hai, thoda-sa bukhar hota hai aur pyaas bilkul nahi lagti.

General.path: Chill, shaking, long-lasting, not relieved by anything
General.en: My shaking chill goes on for a long time and nothing seems to relieve it.
General.hi: कंपकंपी बहुत देर तक रहती है और किसी भी चीज़ से आराम नहीं मिलता।
General.roman: Kampkampi bahut der tak rehti hai aur kisi bhi cheez se aaram nahi milta.

General.path: Chill, shaking, long-lasting, without heat or sweat
General.en: My shaking chill lasts a long time and is not followed by heat or sweating.
General.hi: ठंड लगने के साथ बहुत देर तक कँपकँपी होती है, न बुखार आता है और न पसीना।
General.roman: Thandi lagne ke saath bahut der tak kampkampi hoti hai, na bukhar aata hai aur na pasina.

General.path: Chill, shaking, long-lasting, without, subsequent heat
General.en: My shaking chill lasts a long time and is not followed by heat.
General.hi: ठंड लगने के साथ लंबे समय तक कँपकँपी होती है और उसके बाद बुखार नहीं आता।
General.roman: Thandi lagne ke saath lambe samay tak kampkampi hoti hai aur uske baad bukhar nahi aata.

General.path: Chill, shaking, shivering, rigors
General.en: I get a shaking chill with shivering and rigors (intense whole-body shaking).
General.hi: ठंड लगने के साथ जोर की कँपकँपी और सिहरन होती है।

General sensation.path: Chill, shaking, held, desires to be, so he would not shake so hard

General sensation.hi: इतनी तेज कंपकंपी होती है कि कोई पकड़ कर रोक ले तो थोड़ा आराम मिलेगा ऐसा लगता है।
General sensation.roman: Itni tez kampkampi hoti hai ki koi pakad kar rok le to thoda aaram milega aisa lagta hai.

Triggered by specific situations.en: I get a shaking chill when I come inside from the open air and enter the house.
Triggered by specific situations.hi: बाहर से घर के अंदर आने पर कंपकंपी होती है।
Triggered by specific situations.roman: Bahar se ghar ke andar aane par kampkampi hoti hai.

Triggered by specific situations.path: Chill, shaking, night, air, in the open
Triggered by specific situations.en: I get a shaking chill at night when I am outside in the open air.

Triggered by specific situations.roman: Raat ko khuli hawa mein jane par thandi ke saath kampakampi hoti hai.

Specific body area.roman: Sharir ke kuch hisson mein hi thandi aur kampakampi hoti hai, pure badan mein nahi.

Comes with other symptoms.hi: मिर्गी का दौरा पड़ने से पहले बाईं तरफ ठंड लगती है।

General.roman: Thandi lagne ke saath chehra aur hath nile pad jate hain aur tvcha par dhabbbe se dikhne lagte hain.
