Linked to time of day.roman: Jitni baar bhi nind khulti hai, har baar thandi lag jati hai.

Triggered by weather/temperature.path: Chill, warm, stove
Triggered by weather/temperature.en: A chilly feeling connected to being near a warm stove.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: गर्म अंगीठी के पास बैठने पर भी ठंड लगती है
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: Garm angthi ke paas baithne par bhi thandi lagti hai.

Triggered by weather/temperature.path: Chill, warm, stove, desire to be near
Triggered by weather/temperature.en: You feel chilly and have a strong urge to get close to a warm stove for relief.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: गर्म अंगीठी के पास जाने की इच्छा होती है
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: Garm angthi ke paas jane ki ichchha hoti hai.

Triggered by weather/temperature.path: Chill, warm, stove, desire to be near, but it increases the chill
Triggered by weather/temperature.en: You want to be near a warm stove because of the chills, but getting close to it actually makes the chills worse.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: गर्म अंगीठी के पास जाने की इच्छा होती है लेकिन पास जाने से ठंड और बढ़ जाती है
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: Garm angiithi ke paas jane ki ichchha hoti hai lekin paas jane se thandi aur badh jati hai

Triggered by weather/temperature.path: Chill, warm, stove, desire to be near, cold, and gets sick near
Triggered by weather/temperature.en: You feel chilly and cold, and are drawn to sit near a warm stove, but being near it makes you feel sick.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: ठंड लगती है और अंगीठी के पास जाने की इच्छा होती है, लेकिन पास जाने पर तबीयत और खराब हो जाती है
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: Thandi lagti hai aur angiithi ke paas jane ki ichchha hoti hai, lekin paas jane par tabiyat aur kharab ho jati hai

Triggered by weather/temperature.path: Chill, warm, weather, in
Triggered by weather/temperature.en: A chilly feeling that comes on during warm weather.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: गर्म मौसम में ठंड लगती है
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: Garm mausam mein thandi lagti hai

Triggered by weather/temperature.path: Chill, warm room, agg.
Triggered by weather/temperature.en: Being in a warm room makes the chills worse.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: गर्म कमरे में जाने से ठंड और बढ़ जाती है
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: Garm kamre mein jane se thandi aur badh jati hai.

Triggered by weather/temperature.path: Chill, warm room, amel.
Triggered by weather/temperature.en: Being in a warm room makes the chills better.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: गर्म कमरे में जाने से ठंड में आराम मिलता है
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: Garm kamre mein jane se thandi mein aaram milta hai.

Triggered by weather/temperature.path: Chill, warm room, not amel. in, nor by a warm stove
Triggered by weather/temperature.en: Going into a warm room or sitting near a warm stove does not relieve the chills at all.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: न गर्म कमरे से और न गर्म अंगीठी के पास जाने से ठंड में कोई आराम मिलता है
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: Na garm kamre se aur na garm angthi ke paas jane se thandi mein koi aaram milta hai.

Triggered by weather/temperature.path: Chill, warm room, on coming in from open air
Triggered by weather/temperature.en: A chill comes on when coming indoors into a warm room from the fresh open air.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: बाहर से आकर गर्म कमरे में आने पर ठंड लगने लगती है
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: Bahar se aakar garm kamre mein ane par thandi lagne lagti hai.

Triggered by weather/temperature.path: Chill, warm room, smothering in
Triggered by weather/temperature.en: Being in a warm room brings on a smothering or suffocating feeling along with the chills.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: गर्म कमरे में घुटन महसूस होती है और ठंड लगती है
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: Garm kamre mein ghutan mehsus hoti hai aur thandi lagti hai.

Triggered by specific situations.en: A chilly feeling connected to being in bed or the warmth of bed.
Triggered by specific situations.hi: बिस्तर की गर्मी और ठंड का आपस में संबंध है
Triggered by specific situations.roman: Bistar ki garmi aur thandi ka aapas mein sambandh hai

Triggered by specific situations.en: The warmth of being in bed makes the chills better.
Triggered by specific situations.hi: बिस्तर में लेटने पर ठंड में आराम मिलता है
Triggered by specific situations.roman: Bistar mein letne par thandi mein aaram milta hai

Triggered by specific situations.path: Chill, warmth, bed, amel., but not by external covering
Triggered by specific situations.en: Being in a warm bed helps the chills, but covering up with extra blankets does not add any extra relief.
Triggered by specific situations.hi: बिस्तर की गर्मी से ठंड में आराम मिलता है लेकिन ऊपर से कंबल ओढ़ने से नहीं
Triggered by specific situations.roman: Bistar ki garmi se thandi mein aaram milta hai lekin upar se kambal odhne se nahi

Triggered by specific situations.path: Chill, warmth, bed, amel., but not by heat of stove
Triggered by specific situations.en: Being in a warm bed helps the chills, but the heat from a stove does not give any additional relief.
Triggered by specific situations.hi: बिस्तर की गर्मी से ठंड में आराम मिलता है लेकिन अंगीठी की गर्मी से नहीं
Triggered by specific situations.roman: Bistar ki garmi se thandi mein aaram milta hai lekin angiithi ki garmi se nahi

Triggered by specific situations.path: Chill, warmth, bed, amel., hot irons amel.
Triggered by specific situations.en: Being in a warm bed helps the chills, and applying hot water bottles or heated irons also brings relief.
Triggered by specific situations.hi: बिस्तर की गर्मी से ठंड में आराम मिलता है और गर्म सिकाई से भी आराम मिलता है
Triggered by specific situations.roman: Bistar ki garmi se thandi mein aaram milta hai aur garm sikai se bhi aaram milta hai

Triggered by specific situations.path: Chill, warmth, wrapping up, amel., followed by severe fever and sweat
Triggered by specific situations.en: Wrapping up warmly eases the chills, but this is then followed by a strong fever and heavy sweating.
Triggered by specific situations.hi: कपड़े लपेटने या ओढ़ने से ठंड में आराम मिलता है लेकिन बाद में तेज बुखार और पसीना आता है
Triggered by specific situations.roman: Kapde lapetne ya odhne se thandi mein aaram milta hai lekin baad mein tez bukhar aur paseena ata hai

General.path: Chill, warmth, desire for, which does not relieve
General.en: You crave warmth during the chills, but getting warm does not make them go away.
General.hi: गर्मी की चाहत होती है लेकिन गर्मी से ठंड में कोई राहत नहीं मिलती
General.roman: Garmi ki chahat hoti hai lekin garmi se thandi mein koi rahat nahi milti

Triggered by weather/temperature.path: Chill, warmth, external, amel.
Triggered by weather/temperature.en: Applying external warmth to the body makes the chills better.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: बाहरी गर्मी मिलने से ठंड में आराम होता है
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: Bahari garmi milne se thandi mein aaram hota hai

Triggered by weather/temperature.path: Chill, warmth, sun, desire for
Triggered by weather/temperature.en: During the chills, you have a strong desire to be out in the warmth of the sun.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: धूप में बैठने की इच्छा होती है
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: Dhoop mein baitne ki ichchha hoti hai

Triggered by weather/temperature.path: Chill, warmth, unbearable
Triggered by weather/temperature.en: Any kind of warmth feels completely unbearable during the chills.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: गर्मी बिल्कुल सहन नहीं होती और ठंड लगती है
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: Garmi bilkul sahan nahi hoti aur thandi lagti hai

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Chill, water, as if
Sensation / feel of the area.en: A sensation as if something cold like water is causing the chills.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: ऐसा लगता है जैसे पानी से ठंड लग रही हो
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Aisa lagta hai jaise pani se thandi lag rahi ho

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Chill, water, as if cold water were dashed over him
Sensation / feel of the area.en: A sensation as if cold water has been suddenly thrown or splashed all over the body.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: ऐसा लगता है जैसे कोई ठंडा पानी ऊपर से डाल रहा हो
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Aisa lagta hai jaise koi thanda pani upar se dal raha ho

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Chill, water, as if, poured over him
Sensation / feel of the area.en: A sensation as if cold water is being poured slowly over the body.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: ऐसा लगता है जैसे ठंडा पानी ऊपर से डाला जा रहा हो
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Aisa lagta hai jaise thanda pani upar se dala ja raha ho

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Chill, water, as if, running down the back
Sensation / feel of the area.en: A sensation as if cold water is trickling or running down the back.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: ऐसा लगता है जैसे ठंडा पानी पीठ पर बह रहा हो
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Aisa lagta hai jaise thanda pani pith par bah raha ho

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Chill, water, as if, running, from the clavicles across the chest down to the toes, along the narrow space
Sensation / feel of the area.en: A sensation as if cold water is running from the collarbones, across the chest, and all the way down to the toes along a narrow path.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: ऐसा लगता है जैसे ठंडा पानी कंधे की हड्डी से होते हुए सीने पर और फिर पैर के अंगूठे तक एक पतली धार में बह रहा हो
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Aisa lagta hai jaise thanda pani kandhe ki haddi se hote hue sine par aur phir pair ke anguthe tak ek patli dhar mein bah raha ho

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Chill, water, as if, spurted upon the back
Sensation / feel of the area.en: A sensation as if cold water has been spurted or squirted onto the back.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: ऐसा लगता है जैसे ठंडा पानी पीठ पर छींटे मारा गया हो
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Aisa lagta hai jaise thanda pani pith par chhinte mara gaya ho

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Chill, water, as if, trickled down the back
Sensation / feel of the area.en: A sensation as if cold water is slowly trickling down the back.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: ऐसा लगता है जैसे ठंडा पानी पीठ पर टपक रहा हो
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Aisa lagta hai jaise thanda pani pith par tapak raha ho

Triggered by specific actions.en: Chills that come on after getting wet.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: पानी में भीगने से ठंड लग जाती है
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Pani mein bhigne se thandi lag jati hai

Triggered by specific actions.path: Chill, water, from getting wet, when overheated
Triggered by specific actions.en: Chills that come on after getting wet while the body was already overheated.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: गर्मी में पसीना आने के बाद पानी में भीगने से ठंड लग जाती है
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Garmi mein pasina aane ke baad pani mein bhigne se thandi lag jati hai

Triggered by specific actions.en: Chills that come on from working in water.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: पानी में काम करने से ठंड लग जाती है
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Pani mein kaam karne se thandi lag jati hai

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Chill, wind, as if it were blowing cold
Sensation / feel of the area.en: A sensation as if cold wind is blowing on the body, even when no wind is actually present.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: ऐसा लगता है जैसे ठंडी हवा चल रही हो
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Aisa lagta hai jaise thandi hawa chal rahi ho

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Chill, wind, as if it were blowing cold upon the body
Sensation / feel of the area.en: A sensation as if cold wind is blowing over the whole body, even when no wind is present.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: ऐसा लगता है जैसे पूरे शरीर पर ठंडी हवा चल रही हो
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Aisa lagta hai jaise pure sharir par thandi hawa chal rahi ho

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Chill, wind, as if it were blowing cold, between the shoulder blades
Sensation / feel of the area.en: A sensation as if cold wind is blowing specifically between the shoulder blades.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: ऐसा लगता है जैसे दोनों कंधों के बीच ठंडी हवा चल रही हो
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Aisa lagta hai jaise donon kandhon ke beech thandi hawa chal rahi ho

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Chill, wind, as if it were blowing cold, when walking
Sensation / feel of the area.en: A sensation as if cold wind is blowing on the body, felt especially while walking.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: चलते समय ऐसा लगता है जैसे ठंडी हवा लग रही हो
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Chalte samay aisa lagta hai jaise thandi hawa lag rahi ho

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Chill, wind, as if wind blowing upon soles while body sweating
Sensation / feel of the area.en: A sensation as if cold wind is blowing on the soles of the feet while the rest of the body is sweating.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: शरीर पर पसीना होने के बावजूद पैरों के तलवों पर ठंडी हवा चलने जैसा महसूस होता है
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Sharir par pasina hone ke bawjud pairon ke talwon par thandi hawa chalne jaisa mehsus hota hai

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Chill, wind, sensation as if cold air were spreading from the spine over the body like an epileptic aura
Sensation / feel of the area.en: A sensation of cold air spreading out from the spine across the whole body, similar to the warning feeling before a seizure.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: रीढ़ की हड्डी से ठंडी हवा जैसी लहर निकलकर मिर्गी के दौरे से पहले जैसा एहसास होते हुए पूरे शरीर में फैलती है
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Reedh ki haddi se thandi hawa jaisi lehar nikalkr mirgyi ke daure se pehle jaisa aehsas hote hue pure sharir mein failti hai
